name: MiniApp Factory
description: Register a platform miniapp instance from an audited on-chain template — this writes an on-chain registry record and a catalog patch (not a token contract). You pay only the Neo network fee. After registering, an operator syncs the catalog patch and wires the app to make it launchable.
description_zh: 基于已审计链上模板登记平台小程序实例——这会写入链上注册记录和目录补丁（而非代币合约）。只需支付 Neo 网络费用。登记后由运营者同步目录补丁并接入应用，使其可启动。

aa.description: Template plans can be submitted by AA later, but this standalone app does not require AA.

tee.description: No private computation is required for deterministic miniapp planning.

neodid.description: Developer identity can be layered on top by signing the generated template plan.
